name: Kagerou
source:
Our story unfolds in a small villiage in the mountains, where four men and five women cross paths. 
The game is divided into four chapters, in a channel-surfing style adventure where each chapter has its own protaganist. The actions of the protaganist in one chapter has an effect on the protagonists of the other chapters.

Also, while each chapter has its own individual story, they are really all connected.

[Translation of synopsis from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=8660]Getchu.com[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在一座山间小村庄，四名男子与五名女子在此相遇。
游戏分为四章，以类似切换电视频道的方式展开冒险，每一章都有各自的主人公。其中一章主人公的行动会影响其他章节的主人公。

此外，每章虽然都有独立的故事，实际上却彼此紧密相连。

[简介翻译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=8660]Getchu.com[/url]]
